description:
InstaPrime 0.0.21 brings 196 patches for stock Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 and integrates the latest HushGram parent changes.

### Changes

- Updated native hook discovery for Instagram 456, including profile/inbox/chat popups, message gestures and inbox header controls.
- Restored accent backgrounds behind both inbox row layouts and the Activity feed, with focused real-APK regression coverage.
- Accent splash now uses a dark tone close to the settings background. With accent splash off, Instagram's default launcher background is inherited, including Pure black dark mode's override.
- Grouped new parent settings into existing untitled sections. Preserved independent DM Settings and Compose controls.
- Includes parent additions such as call recording, notification bubbles, Select messages, saved-collection locking and expanded reel filtering.
- Fixed merge-related compilation and popup test issues; updated the check-and-build helper for current fixtures and dependencies.

### Validation

The attached MPP matches the current source's embedded build identity. Saved focused native results show 15 passed and two skipped cases; saved UI results show 397 passed, zero failures. The row-accent real-APK check passed. No new tests or build were run during publishing. A full upstream test gate and full device walkthrough were not performed.

### Known limitations

Native accent splash is a close dark match, not a pixel-exact copy of the runtime wallpaper-derived settings background. Message menu/reaction spacing and empty composer + auto-hide remain deferred. Keep in Chat does not permanently archive media; updates or restarts may leave unavailable media placeholders.

### Install

Use a matching stock Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 APK, Android 9 or newer, and Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. Refresh the InstaPrime source or import the attached patches-0.0.21.mpp. The SBOM, build information and SHA-256 checksums are attached.

Core patches and upstream maintenance are by SysAdminDoc and HushGram contributors.
Original project: https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram
